evals.prompt: This function won't compile and I don't understand why. Can you explain what's wrong and fix it?
evals.expected_output: Identifies E0502, explains that the immutable borrow of words[0] is still live when push() takes a mutable borrow, and fixes it by ending the first borrow before the push. Cites the error index.
expectations: The skill ran oxidize diagnose on the file rather than guessing the error
The answer names error code E0502
The explanation describes the overlap between the immutable and mutable borrow
The proposed fix compiles (verified by a second diagnose run)
The answer cites a doc.rust-lang.org URL
The fix does not reach for .clone() or Rc<RefCell<_>> when sequencing the borrows suffices
